LanguageData.CC_PW_Reason_NewSpecies: {PAWN_nameDef} has a way with animals, and there's a wild {SPECIES} out there of a kind nobody here has caught.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_PokemonSounds_Tip: The cries PokéWorld gives its Pokémon, or the calls of other animals. Each species borrows the voice of an animal picked by its body, its types and its size: one of your other mods' animals where it fits the species better and has a call of its own, otherwise one of the base game's, where insects click, birds cluck, quack or honk, bats squeak, big beasts growl or roar, and the stones, balls, gases, ice, shells and fish take a tortoise's voice. It never calls more often than PokéWorld had it.
LanguageData.CC_PokemonSounds_Creatures_Tip: Each species calls with the voice of an animal picked by its body, types and size, another mod's where it fits better, else the base game's, never more often than before.
LanguageData.CC_PokemonSounds_Rarer_Tip: PokéWorld's own cries, a third as often.
LanguageData.CC_PokemonSounds_Own_Tip: PokéWorld's own cries, as often as the mod has them.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_PokemonSounds_Creatures: Each species calls like an animal of its body, types and size, another mod's where it fits better.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_PokemonSounds_Rarer: Their own cries, with three times as long between calls.
